description_expanded: Why Guests Love Staying at Sundaze* Short walk to Ed Walline Public Beach Access* Community pool directly behind the home (just 23 steps away)* 4 complimentary bikes included* Beautiful outdoor spaces – private patio and balcony* All bedrooms feature ensuite bathrooms* Private community with only 15 homes* Snorkel the nearby Seahorse Reef* Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support* Snowbird-friendly with low monthly winter ratesWelcome to Sundaze, your home away from home in the charming Gulf Reflections community just off Scenic 30A near Gulf Place. Tucked into a quiet neighborhood and just a short stroll to the beach, this spacious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat is thoughtfully designed for gathering, relaxing, and making lasting memories. Step inside to a bright, open-concept living area perfect for spending time together after a day in the sun. The fully equipped kitchen features an extended breakfast bar — ideal for morning coffee, family breakfasts, or evening cocktails. This home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests, and every bedroom includes a private ensuite bathroom — providing both comfort and privacy for everyone in your group.Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 12 Comfortably)1st FloorGuest Bedroom: King BedLiving Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa2nd FloorPrimary Suite: King Bed with private balcony accessGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed + Full-over-Full Bunk Bed*All bedrooms include private ensuite bathrooms.* When it’s time to unwind, you can:-Relax on the private back patio-Enjoy sunset views from the balcony-Cool off in the community pool just steps away-23 Steps!-Cruise 30A on one of the four included bikesLocated near the heart of Gulf Place in Santa Rosa Beach, you’ll enjoy:-Boutique shopping-Local restaurants and live music-Palm-lined walking paths-Green spaces and art galleries-Easy access to the scenic 30A bike trailSnorkel the Seahorse ReefAdventure seekers will love exploring the Seahorse Reef, an artificial reef located just offshore near Topsail Hill Preserve. Now a thriving habitat for marine life, it’s a favorite destination for snorkelers. For the best experience, we recommend accessing the reef by paddleboard or kayak, as conditions can vary.Snowbird InformationWe welcome snowbirds! January and February are available for monthly stays. Arrival must be on the 1st of the month and departure must be on the 1st of the month. There is a $150 additional cleaning fee applies to monthly stays. Please message us for a custom quote.Important Policies-Guests must be 25+ to book (no exceptions)-No events or parties-Professionally managed 24/7 for a smooth, worry-free stay Read less
